tom_billing: Heads up — vendor 'NetStream' issued a credit for $12,450 on invoice #7890 (vendor id 4729). They describe it as a 'network surcharge correction' covering 2025-01 through 2025-06. No PO on file. How should we treat this for revrec/deferrals? cc @maya @ben_fin @ana_ops

maya: Do we have a breakdown of how much affects recognized revenue vs future unearned periods?

tom_billing: Vendor note shows a split: $7,450 applies to usage billed/recognized in 2025-01–2025-03; $5,000 applies to 2025-04–2025-06 (unearned). I uploaded the vendor memo to the ticket.

invoice-bot: Attached: https://files.redwood/internal/invoices/VCM-7890-invoice-7890-credit.pdf

ben_fin: Need backup before posting. If $7,450 reverses revenue already recognized, post as contra-rev this month. The $5k for future service should reduce unearned revenue. Can you confirm customer mapping and which revenue schedules to update?

ana_ops: quick note — mapping confirmed to customer group 'CloudEdge' acct 10023. Original revenue schedules are REV-2025-01-CE (recognized) and REV-2025-04-CE (deferred). Suggest we reverse the recognized schedule and reduce the deferred schedule.

ben_fin: Draft JEs for review:
```journal
# reverse recognized portion (recognized historical revenue)
Dr Revenue Contrarevenue (GL 4200) 7,450
Cr Customer Credits Payable (GL 2210) 7,450

# reduce unearned (future period)
Dr Unearned Revenue (GL 2020) 5,000
Cr Customer Credits Payable (GL 2210) 5,000
```
Tag both to contract C-889 and include vendor credit memo #VCM-7890 for audit.

maya: Quick flag — if AR was paid by customer already, we shouldn’t credit AR. Using Customer Credits Payable is fine so we can issue a credit memo to the customer. Also confirm tax treatment (is the credit gross or net of tax?).

tom_billing: AR was partially collected (customer paid invoices in Jan/Feb). Vendor credit is gross (no tax line). Proposed final flow: create single customer credit liability and apply to open customer ledger. JEs above look good. I will attach cash/AR status to the ticket.

ben_fin: OK. Once ticket has vendor pdf + contract mapping + AR status I'll approve JE posting. Also running through impact: this will reduce recognized revenue by 7,450 (contra-revenue) and reduce deferred liability by 5,000. Please ensure we update revenue schedules so downstream dashboards reflect the change.

ana_ops: Action items: 1) tom to file accounting ticket with attachments + contract id C-889 + AR status 2) ben to approve JE 3) ops to update REV-2025-04-CE (-5,000) and add lineage note linking to VCM-7890 and this thread 4) maya to run QoQ revenue regression check and alert product if thresholds hit.

maya: Also add note to roll forward plan: if vendor issues similar surcharge corrections going forward we should include vendor credit handling in the month-end checklist.

 tom_billing: Will submit ticket now and ping when done. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

ben_fin: Approved in principle pending attachments. :+1:

maya: Thanks — please include the ticket number in this thread when created so auditors have the trail.
